# Reconstructed Nokia 3310 handset fonts

Source: https://github.com/pjanx/nokia-3310-fonts

Copyright (c) 2013, Přemysl Eric Janouch.

The upstream `nokia-fonts.c` and `nokia-fonts.h` contain an explicit permissive grant to use, copy, modify, and distribute the software for any purpose with or without fee. The full notice is retained in both source headers and reproduced in `LICENSE.txt`.

These glyphs were reconstructed by the author by observing a phone screen, as explained in the upstream `README`; they are not extracted firmware. `scripts/fonts.mjs` converts the licensed C glyph tables to `src/fonts.json`, preserving the earlier player's glyph rows, advances, and line spacing.
